exact_cwe_mechanism.evidence: The code performs an authorization check via allowed_for_local_cluster() but the demonstrated vulnerability is command injection, not incorrect authorization. CWE-863 requires the authorization mechanism itself to be flawed, not bypassed through a separate injection vulnerability.

connection.evidence: User-controlled parameters (params[:watchdog] and params[:config]) are directly interpolated into command arguments and passed to run_cmd, which executes external commands

diff_causality.evidence: If this candidate line were reverted, the vulnerable command execution with user-controlled arguments would not occur. The addition of this line creates the command execution pathway.

security_control.required_control: Input validation and sanitization for command arguments
security_control.control_requirement_evidence: Command injection vulnerabilities require validation/sanitization of user input before passing to command execution
security_control.deficiency_evidence: No input validation or sanitization is performed on user-provided watchdog paths or config values before interpolation into command arguments

concrete_impact.evidence: Command injection could allow arbitrary command execution with the privileges of the pcsd service, though the exact impact depends on service privileges and system configuration

diff_counterfactual: If the candidate line were reverted, the remote_enable_sbd function would not execute the external pcs command with user-controlled arguments, preventing the command injection vulnerability.
supporting_evidence: User-controlled params[:watchdog] and params[:config] are directly interpolated into command arguments without sanitization
Arguments are passed to run_cmd which executes external commands
No input validation is performed on the user-provided values
contradicting_evidence: The authorization check (allowed_for_local_cluster) appears to be correctly implemented and is not the source of the vulnerability
The demonstrated mechanism is command injection, not incorrect authorization
unresolved_facts: Whether the pcs command properly handles special characters in arguments
Specific attack vectors through the web interface
Privilege level of the pcsd service
